content: Electron stable is 44.4.3 (Chromium 152, Node 24.21) per releases.electronjs.org 2026-09-18; supported window is the latest three majors (42,43,44), so Electron 32.3.3 (Chromium 128, Node 20.18) pinned in Tapestry app is out of support. WebGPU shipped by default in Chrome 113 on macOS/Windows/ChromeOS, so every Electron >=25 exposes navigator.gpu on macOS without flags; the enable-unsafe-webgpu flag is a Linux concern (electron#41763).
